candidates.title: PDAcc: A 541 Tokens/s@Llama-1.2B Effective Throughput Prefill-Decode Disaggregated MCM-based Accelerator for Multi-task Large Language Model Applications
candidates.venue: International Symposium on Security in Computing and Communications
candidates.abstract: Abstrack: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as the backbone of many modern AI applications. LLM inference has two stages: prefill processes the full input at once, which is compute heavy and relatively time-consuming; in contrast, decode then generates tokens autoregressively with little per-step work. The two stages require markedly different resources, and unpredictable task arrivals and sequence lengths often force them to run concurrently in multi-tenant inference, as shown in Fig. 1. Co-optimization must therefore be considered to preserve effective throughput (ETPS)-tokens per second over the full request (prefill and decode combined). Aggregating the prefill and decode stages into a mixed batch enhances weight utilization [1–3]. However, the execution time of prefill and decode accumulates, causing longer latency and preventing separate optimization strategies for the two stages.
candidates.reason: 計算集約的なprefillと逐次的なdecodeで必要資源が異なる点に着目し、prefill-decode分離型のMCMアクセラレータPDAccでLlama-1.2Bの実効スループット541 tokens/sを狙う設計であり、LLM推論の分離実行への直接的貢献が確認できる。
